must_close.why_release_critical: The final release must preserve the frozen scientific package and claim-state distribution.
must_close.exit_condition: Completeness certificate, claim ledger, negative results, and all nine blocked M18 claims validate without drift.

must_close.why_release_critical: The public observatory must remain a deterministic translation of qualified evidence.
must_close.exit_condition: Public narrative, readiness, catalog/explorer support surfaces, and historical context validators remain green.

must_close.why_release_critical: The release needs a verified canonical public URL backed by the validated static site artifact.
must_close.resolution: Repository Settings → Pages → Build and deployment → Source was changed to GitHub Actions by the repository owner.
must_close.exit_condition: Deploy Public Product completes and the production URL serves the canonical site artifact.

must_close.why_release_critical: Final delivery needs one clean-main CI sweep after all release-critical integration work is merged.
must_close.exit_condition: All release-critical deterministic validators and relevant regression suites pass from the same clean main candidate.

must_close.why_release_critical: The final product must be understandable without weakening caveats or hiding negative results.
must_close.exit_condition: Mobile/desktop navigation, copy, terminology, failure states, blocked claims, and evidence-state labels receive a final adversarial pass with only blocker fixes remaining.

must_close.why_release_critical: The project needs one named immutable candidate plus concise release/handoff metadata rather than an indefinitely moving main branch.
must_close.exit_condition: A release-candidate commit is named, audited, and accompanied by final release notes/status/citation or handoff metadata as appropriate.

valuable_if_easy.rule: Only add an already-qualified result when it materially improves public understanding and can be derived deterministically from canonical evidence.

Do not mass-delete acquisition infrastructure. If a release-critical change touches an old live-probe workflow, prefer manual-only or deterministic validation unless live transport is still necessary.
Improve release notes, citation metadata, and repository navigation only when it directly reduces final handoff ambiguity.

defer.reopen_trigger: A contemporaneous revision note, weighting formula, or reproducible old/new frame bridge is recovered.

defer.reason: The legacy PPID migration/access boundary is frozen; companion evidence cannot substitute for the missing raw official artifact.
defer.reopen_trigger: A semantically verified official archival locator or raw PDF becomes available.

defer.reason: The frozen M18 claim gate explicitly blocks a single definitive monetary wasted-potential number.
defer.reopen_trigger: A defensible identification and valuation design satisfying the claim gate is developed in future work.

defer.reason: Current empirical gaps do not identify a theoretical maximum or guaranteed gain from closing those gaps.
defer.reopen_trigger: A separate defensible structural/causal design supports those constructs.

defer.reason: Current evidence is descriptive/predictive and does not identify a causal rainfall→unemployment effect.
defer.reopen_trigger: A credible causal identification strategy and required data become available.

defer.reason: The project intentionally keeps disaster components separate and does not authorize a synthetic risk score, treatment-effect interpretation, or ranked policy/cost-benefit list.
defer.reopen_trigger: Future research defines and validates explicit weighting, causal, and decision criteria.
